clips.title: The story
paras: Syndicate cutthroats hold Corrahn's Dagger, the second ridge among northern Hillsbrad's four rocky fingers. They use its high ground as a hideout.

Corrahn's Dagger rises in northern Hillsbrad Foothills as the second of four rocky ridges called the fingers of Hillsbrad. Syndicate cutthroats overrun the ridge and use its height to watch the valley below.
